crossTargetConclusion: The creator-video idea that changing stake may matter is false as a generic spin-count ritual, but exact current Spanish operator rules now prove multiple titles where changing the bet selects a genuinely different persistent state. EDGE therefore scans state, not arbitrary spin counts.
